strategy.thesis: A fund-of-funds launched under Taiwan's Fintech Industry Alliance, led by KGI Financial Holding's CDIB Capital arm, that commits capital into venture funds with at least 40% allocated to the Taiwan VC market and to fintech applicable to Taiwan; focus areas include blockchain, AI, big data, digital payments and financial inclusion technology.

summary.en: An innovation/fintech fund-of-funds launched February 2025 under Taiwan's Fintech Industry Alliance, spearheaded by KGI Financial Holding (formerly China Development Financial) and its CDIB Capital arm. Initial target NT$6–7.5bn, potentially exceeding NT$10bn with National Development Fund co-investment; at least 40% earmarked for the Taiwan VC market.
summary.local: 2025年2月在金融科技產業聯盟下啟動的創新科技母基金,由凱基金控（原開發金控）旗下中華開發資本主導。初始規模規劃新台幣60～75億元,搭配國發基金共同投資可達100億元以上,至少40%資金投入台灣創投市場,聚焦區塊鏈、AI、大數據、數位支付及金融普惠技術。

aka: 中華開發資本股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Asia-focused alternatives platform under KGI Financial Holding deploying multiple strategies: private credit (mezzanine, secured/structured debt, securitization), mid-market buyouts, growth equity, early- and late-stage venture, plus exposure to venture/growth secondaries (LP in Pinegrove Opportunity Partners I) and private-fund advisory for institutional investors.

application.how_to_apply: Institutional; via CDIB Capital Group website / KGI Financial

summary.en: CDIB Capital Group, tracing its roots to the 1959 China Development Trust, is the private debt and equity investment platform of KGI Financial Holding (formerly China Development Financial). It manages over US$2.5bn and deploys private credit, mid-market buyouts, growth equity, early/late-stage venture, structured credit and special situations. It is active in venture/growth secondaries, having committed as an LP to Silicon Valley secondaries firm Pinegrove Opportunity Partners I (US$2.2bn debut fund).
summary.local: 中華開發資本源自1959年成立的中華開發信託,為凱基金控（原開發金控）旗下私募債權與股權投資管理平台,管理超過25億美元自有與第三方資本,投資策略涵蓋私募債權、中小企業槓桿收購、成長期投資、早期與晚期創投、結構債及特殊事件投資,並透過投資矽谷創投二級市場基金 Pinegrove Opportunity Partners I 參與創投二級市場。

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's flagship national-policy VC, co-founded by the National Development Fund (40% owner) and private enterprises, investing in the government's 5+2 strategic industries. Manages the NDF-entrusted Central & Eastern Europe Investment Fund (a delegated, government-LP capital vehicle) and multiple tech/biotech funds, often co-investing with sovereign/bank LPs.

summary.en: Founded August 2017 and 40%-owned by Taiwan's National Development Fund, Taiwania Capital is the country's flagship national-policy VC. By 2024 it managed ~US$1bn across eight funds. It manages the NDF-entrusted NT$6bn (US$200M) Central & Eastern Europe Investment Fund — a delegated, government-LP capital vehicle — and the US$200M TaiAx Life Science Fund (with Tokyo's Axil Capital), whose LPs include the NDF, Mizuho Securities and Mega Bank.
summary.local: 台杉投資2017年8月成立,由國發基金（持股40%）與民間企業共同創立,是台灣國家級政策創投。2024年管理規模約10億美元、共八檔基金,並受國發基金委託管理規模新台幣60億元（2億美元）的中東歐投資基金,以及與日本 Axil Capital 合資、目標2億美元的 TaiAx 生技基金（LP含國發基金、瑞穗證券、兆豐銀行）。

aka: 國泰私募股權股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's first private equity fund manager established by an investment-trust (SITE) company under Cathay Financial Holdings. Operates limited-partnership funds as GP, pooling capital from domestic institutions, insurers, pension funds, government funds and high-net-worth professional investors (LPs) into counter-cyclical, stable-return targets; debut PE fund targets circular economy, green energy and other strategic sustainability industries.

application.how_to_apply: Institutional / professional investors via Cathay SITE

summary.en: Established November 2017 and 100%-owned by Cathay Securities Investment Trust (Cathay SITE) under Cathay Financial Holdings, Cathay Private Equity was the first PE fund manager in Taiwan approved by the FSC for an investment-trust company to set up. It runs limited-partnership funds as GP, aggregating LP capital from domestic institutions, insurers, pension and government funds and HNWIs; its debut PE fund targets circular economy, green-energy and strategic sustainability sectors.
summary.local: 國泰私募股權2017年11月成立,由國泰金控旗下國泰證券投資信託100%持有,為國內第一家獲金管會核准由投信業者跨足設立的私募股權基金。採有限合夥模式由本公司擔任GP,匯集國內機構法人、保險業、退休基金、政府基金及高資產族群等LP資金,首檔基金鎖定循環經濟、綠能科技等永續關鍵產業。

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's sovereign development fund. Beyond direct startup investments and the NT$10bn angel co-investment program, it invests indirectly as a cornerstone LP into Taiwan venture capital funds (a de facto fund-of-funds), seeding multiple domestic VC vehicles (e.g., Taiwania Capital, Darwin Ventures) and entrusting policy funds to managers.

application.how_to_apply: Via NDF investment programs (df.gov.tw); angel program via angelinvestment.org.tw; VC funds apply for NDF LP commitments under review guidelines

summary.en: Taiwan's National Development Fund is the sovereign development fund of the Executive Yuan, with net value of ~NT$2.09 trillion (Dec 2024). It performs both direct investment (70 enterprises, NT$77.232bn cost) and indirect investment as an LP into Taiwan VC funds — effectively a national fund-of-funds — and runs the NT$10bn angel co-investment program. It is the anchor LP behind firms such as Taiwania Capital (40% owner) and Darwin Ventures (one-third of its sixth fund).
summary.local: 行政院國家發展基金為台灣主權發展基金,截至2024年12月淨值約新台幣2.09兆元。除直接投資（70家企業、投資成本約772.32億元)外,也透過投資創投基金進行間接投資,實質扮演國家級母基金角色,並辦理規模新台幣100億元的創業天使投資方案;為台杉投資（持股40%）、達盈管顧（第六號基金三分之一資金）等多家創投的關鍵LP。
